thread:
maria: FYI found a ~6h hole in agg_hours (eu) for 2026-03-20. Proposing targeted backfill tonight 02:00 UTC. Need queue affinity so we don't starve realtime. :eyes:
aj: lowprio pool + aggressive preempt. Can we protect prod tenants via tenant-priority routing?
kevin: fairshare tokens are global today. We could add a backfill_affinity tag + tenant-priority policy to scheduler so prod keeps priority.
linh: If we use affinity, ensure backfills avoid KV warmups. Use smaller batches and KV-less warmup flag. Memory spikes were an issue last time.
maria: Also want a dry-run to estimate GPU-hours, ETA, and cost. Console should show estimated token-hours in the modal.
sam: Dry-run can simulate with last-week profile over a tiny window. CLI flag --dry-run to emit estimates + sample artifact.
kevin: sample CLI: ri backfill create --target=agg_hours --range=2026-03-20..2026-03-20 --queue=backfill-lowprio --dry-run --canary=0.01
kevin: dry-run output: est GPU-hours, tenant list, sample rows, dedupe-rate. Upload artifact to s3.
linh: Dedupe caution: overlapping late rows can double-count. Preflight should check idempotent upsert keys and TTL reconciliation.
nancy: UI: add preflight badge (passed/failed) linking to sample artifact and diff expectations. Cuts down manual ops.
aj: Fallback policy: if lowprio saturates, route to dedicated nodes with strict per-tenant rate limits instead of spilling into realtime.
maria: Plan: dry-run 22:00 UTC, review 23:00, manual approve for 02:00. Who owns dry-run?
kevin: I'll run it and post results. ops-bot, schedule pagerless window 02:00-05:00 for this backfill.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window: telemetry-backfill-eu 02:00-05:00 UTC	6 notifications to #eng-oncall.
sam: UX ask: show "expected budget burn" in modal pulled from dry-run artifact.
maria: Canary 1% tenants -> console diff view. Abort if diffs >0.5%.
linh: I'll add an automated diff job to validate canary vs baseline and emit pass/fail.
kevin: dry-run started, artifact s3://ri-backfill/dryruns/4820001234.json
kevin: dry-run results: est 1.4 GPU-hours, est cost $30, dedupe ~0.25%, full ETA ~2h.
maria: Approve manual kickoff if no objections by 00:30 UTC. React :thumbsup:.
nancy: Added precheck flag and canary threshold note in UI.
aj: Ops note: label spare nodes with backfill=true so kernel eviction won't affect realtime.
dave: Also add quota leash per-tenant to prevent noisy neighbors from consuming dedicated fallback.
kevin: launched canary at 02:00 UTC (0.5% tenants). ops-bot: job tb-4820001234-canary started.
kevin: canary diff 0.02% -> pass. escalating slowly to 10%.
maria: If any metric breaches abort and tag incident backfill-rollback.
kevin: bulk started with queue backfill-lowprio, affinity backfill=true. ops-bot: job tb-4820001234-bulk est finish 04:10 UTC.
sam: console shows expected budget burn ~$1.9k for full run. ping finance.
maria: Add postmortem checklist: consider reducing default batch size for EU business hours.
kevin: job finished 03:55 UTC. final diff 0.05%. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
